meta.title: The Cursed Island
meta.subtitle: A lost island filled with treasure… and something far worse.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: Land Ho
scenes.narrative:
Your ship creaks as it approaches a fog-covered island.

Legends say no crew that has landed here ever returned… but also that unimaginable treasure lies hidden deep within.

Your crew looks to you for a decision.

scenes.title: The Silent Shore
scenes.narrative:
You step onto the beach. The sand is undisturbed, no footprints, no birds, no sound.

A dense jungle waits ahead, and a broken shipwreck lies to your left.

scenes.title: Jagged Cliffs
scenes.narrative:
You sail around the island and discover sharp cliffs with a hidden cave entrance at water level.

The tide is low enough to enter—for now.

scenes.title: Scouting Party
scenes.narrative:
You send a small crew ahead.

Minutes pass. Then an hour. The boat returns… empty.

Something is wrong.

scenes.title: The Wreck
scenes.narrative:
The remains of an old ship are scattered across the sand.

Inside, you find a journal and a rusted key.

choices.text: Take the key and head inland

scenes.title: The Warning
scenes.narrative:
The journal tells of a cursed treasure guarded by something that cannot die.

The last entry reads: DO NOT TAKE THE GOLD.

scenes.title: The Jungle Path
scenes.narrative:
The jungle is thick and humid. Strange sounds echo all around.

You find a split path: one leads to ancient ruins, the other to a dark cave.

scenes.title: The Sea Cave
scenes.narrative:
Inside the cave, glowing algae lights the walls.

You dock your ship and find a hidden tunnel leading deeper into the island.

scenes.title: Ancient Ruins
scenes.narrative:
Massive stone structures stand covered in vines.

At the center is a locked stone door.

scenes.title: The Dark Cave
scenes.narrative:
The cave is pitch black. You hear breathing… but you are alone.

Suddenly, glowing eyes appear in the darkness.

scenes.title: The Guardian
scenes.narrative:
A massive skeletal figure steps forward.

It does not attack. Instead, it gestures toward a hidden passage.

It seems to be testing you.

scenes.title: The Treasure
scenes.narrative:
You enter a massive chamber filled with gold, jewels, and ancient artifacts.

At the center sits a cursed chest glowing faintly.

scenes.title: The True Treasure
scenes.narrative:
Inside the chest is not gold, but a glowing artifact.

It grants you knowledge and power beyond imagination.

You leave the island forever changed.

scenes.title: The Curse
scenes.narrative:
The moment you grab the gold, the chamber shakes.

Your crew begins turning into skeletons before your eyes.

You realize too late… the treasure was never meant to be taken.

scenes.title: The Smart Pirate
scenes.narrative:
You leave the treasure untouched.

As you escape, the island begins to disappear into the fog.

You live to sail another day.

scenes.title: The Escape
scenes.narrative:
You leave the island behind.

You may never know what was hidden there, but you survived.

scenes.title: Turning Back
scenes.narrative:
You decide it is not worth the risk.

You sail away, leaving the mystery unsolved forever.

scenes.title: The Trap
scenes.narrative:
You force the door open.

Arrows shoot from the walls. The ruins collapse around you.

The island claims another victim.

scenes.title: Lost to the Island
scenes.narrative:
Whatever was watching you in the darkness attacks.

You never make it out.
